title: पचास applications के बाद offer आया, और वो तुम्हें लूटने आया था
look: illustrated story by day (brand/story.js, brand/scenes.js), my face and body in the hoodie, a drawn WhatsApp-style chat with a fake HR whose mask comes off, Ananya as the friend at the end, compact captions
sendTo: उस दोस्त को जो अभी job ढूँढ रहा है
style: Natural conversational Hindi as spoken in India, like a friend who tells you a short true-to-life story and lets you in on a useful check. English words in Indian English. Confident, clear and brisk, one even tone for the whole story, with only a short breath between sentences. No acting, no exaggeration.
sources: https://who.is/whois/infosys.com (captured 2026-10-17, no sign-in): 'WHOIS Domain Lookup. Look up registration details, contacts, and nameservers for any domain name'; 'Important Dates: Created July 17, 1992'. Shown as an example of an old, real company website; the voice does not name the company.

Fake job offers in India: a request for money (registration, training, laptop, deposit) is the main warning sign; offers without a real interview and contact only on WhatsApp are others; report at 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in. https://pulseofnoida.com/education/skill-development-careers/job-internship-scams-india-red-flags-3122/ , https://the420.in/ai-trap-fake-job-offers-india-job-seekers-scams-how-to-avoid/
The company in the story (NextGen Tech, nextgen-careers.in) and its age of six days are invented for the story and shown only on the drawn laptop, never on the real who.is page.

sentences: पचास applications के बाद offer आया, और वो तुम्हें लूटने आया था।
WhatsApp पर HR का message आया।
Interview हुआ ही नहीं, फिर भी सीधा offer letter।
बस joining से पहले पाँच हज़ार की training fee भरनी थी।
पहली job थी, तुम pay करने ही वाले थे।
लेकिन तभी नज़र letter पर लिखी website पर गई।
who.is पर किसी भी website का नाम डालो।
यह बताता है कि website कब बनी थी।
असली companies की website सालों पुरानी होती है।
असली company job देने के पैसे कभी नहीं माँगती।
अगले दिन उस HR का number बंद था।
Comment में कुछ भी लिख दो।
उस दोस्त को भेजो जो अभी job ढूँढ रहा है।
